reason: v12's directive regex treats an unclosed `%%{` as a directive and removes it, with the rest of the text after it (or, with a word argument, up to that word's end), so later statements vanish; v13's preprocess keeps the text and reports UNCLOSED_DIRECTIVE, so the chart is rejected rather than silently cut (core preprocess behaviour, as for quadrant and radar; GAPS #507, #508). The generated variants are left out of the parity corpus (`xychart/corpus.ts`).
